item.title: Tagata Jinja and the Honen Matsuri: Japan's Famous Fertility Festival — Guide
item.description: Tagata Jinja, an ancient shrine near Komaki north of Nagoya, is home to the Honen Matsuri, Japan’s most famous fertility festival, held every year on March 15th. The rite is exactly what its reputation promises and older than embarrassment: a team of men carries a newly carved hinoki-cypress owasegata — some 2.5 metres long and several hundred kilos — in procession between shrines, accompanied by sake barrels, banner bearers and shrine maidens, as a prayer for bountiful harvests, prosperity and children.
